svg.text: BUILD METHOD / FIRST ACCESS AND CAP HANDOVER
Work from the existing city model / half-step geometry and temporary closures kept separate from permanent quantities

ALL BOUNDS INCLUSIVE / NO WORLD ANCHOR OR SURVEYED Y / CIVIL DESIGN, NOT GAME-TESTED
Confirm P0 survey and stake the work envelope, reserved hall edges and relevant road offsets.
Use required-clear runs and structural coordinates to identify corridor/ stair space. Do not
excavate the full work-order rectangle or blank parcels.

Install listed slab stairs/ supports where assigned, then temporary frontier caps for the
end-of-order state. Remove obsolete caps only after the adjoining new section is ready.
Inspect access and junctions before gallery roof Y-4, road/ path base Y-2 and surface Y-1. Keep
required-clear cells and walking lanes unobstructed.
Check permanent counts, cap state and unresolved lighting/ edge protection before recording
the work order as built. No automatic completion or game safety is implied.

rectangles overlap; ownership masks remove duplicate permanent
